title: Reading list
audience: For readers whose to-read pile lives in screenshots and browser tabs.
description: A reading list with ratings and notes. Tell your AI about a book and it files it; ask it what to read next.
tagline: Books to read, reading and finished.
seoTitle: Reading list template with notes for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Reading list

Every book you want to read, are reading or have finished. Add one in the table, or tell your AI about a book and it files it.

## Books
<!-- pane-table: Title=text; Author=text; Status=choice To read|Reading|Finished|Dropped; Rating (1–5)=scale 1-5; Why=text -->
| Title | Author | Status | Rating (1–5) | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Notes
A few lines on each book once you've read it.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Reading list". Read it with fetch before each change. When I mention a book, add a row to the table with edit: Title, Author, Status To read, and in Why, who recommended it or why I want it. When I start or finish a book, update its Status (and Rating from 1 to 5 when I finish). Put my thoughts on a book under "Notes", under a "###" heading with the title. When I ask what to read next, suggest from what's marked To read, based on what I rated highly.

asks: Ask which book I want to add, who recommended it and why, then file it.
